event_name: Date 28 July 2019 Time 17:45 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 16 was released unsafely from a pit stop.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence of the incident and determined that the car was released into the path of the approaching car 8. The cars made minor contact as a result. The Stewards did note that the driver Leclerc drove at an acute angle to avoid a tyre changer in the next pit and had no opportunity to drive in the merge area.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Ferrari Unsafe Release Of Car 16
